title: Get approval to build in a mine subsidence district
what: Erect or alter an improvement, or subdivide land, in a mine subsidence district only with the approval of the Chief Executive of Subsidence Advisory NSW.

sources.title: Coal Mine Subsidence Compensation Act 2017 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out work, or cause work to be done, in connection with the erection or alteration of an improvement within a mine subsidence district, except in accordance with the approval of the Chief Executive.

reach.condition: if it builds or alters improvements in a mine subsidence district
